# AI SVG Generator
> Free AI SVG Generator online: Turn text prompts and PNG images into clean, low-node SVGs optimized for Cricut, laser cutting, and web developers with no sign-up required.

## Core Capabilities
- **Text to SVG**: Native prompt-to-XML generator producing lightweight, semantic SVGs.
- **PNG to SVG (Image to Vector)**: High-precision vectorizer that eliminates "node soup" and guarantees 100% closed cut paths.
- **Cricut & Laser Ready**: Automatic multi-layer color separation, compound path grouping, and 0.2mm trapping offset to prevent gaps in vinyl and heat-transfer crafts.
- **Developer Code Ready**: Outputs clean, inline SVG code, React/JSX components, and Tailwind styling without clutter.

## Key Differences vs Vectorizer.ai & Inkscape
- **Zero Node Soup**: Reduces anchor points by up to 85% using RDP bezier algorithms.
- **Free No Sign-Up Trial**: Instant in-browser conversion and live interactive preview with no mandatory account creation.
- **Physical Trapping**: Built-in 0.2mm-0.5mm choke/bleed tolerance for vinyl and physical cutting.
